name: mojulo
description: The mojulo plugin, published by Franz Ombico from the zombico/mojulo repository: a local 3D compiler MCP server for Claude.

plugins.name: mojulo
plugins.description: A 3D compiler for Claude Code: build objects, walkable worlds and games by conversation as small recipes on your machine, exported to STL/3MF, glTF, HTML or Godot. No account, no external telemetry.
